title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood toy shop: an exchange-period notice, a first day working the counter, a store-usage guide, a repair-hours-change notice, an online-reservation guide, a reflection on age labels versus a child's own taste, a first repair consultation, the shop's history from retailer to custom wooden toys, a points-and-repair-service guide, a 3D-printer-for-repairs trend column, a hybrid membership-rank system guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and repair craft, and an annual report.
